description: This file defines an Angular standalone component named 'RecipeCardComponent' which displays a recipe card and interacts with the RecipeService to toggle favorites and calculate total preparation time.

classes.name: RecipeCardComponent
classes.description: An Angular component for displaying recipe information and handling user interactions such as toggling favorite status.

methods.name: totalTime
methods.description: Calculates the total time required for a recipe by summing preparatory and cooking times.

methods.name: toggleFavorite
methods.description: Handles the click event to toggle the favorite status of a recipe, preventing default event propagation.
